extras.textures: PBR 4096px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.notes: lies flat; top edge (-X) holds the CPU socket area, rear edge (+Y) the I/O cover with USB, LAN, display and five colour-ringed audio jacks; blue PCB with baked traces, vias, mounting holes and silkscreen outlines (no text); CPU socket with gold contact field, load plate and lever, L-shaped white VRM heat sinks with aluminium fins, chokes and capacitors, four DIMM slots, 24-pin and 8-pin power connectors, four PCIe slots (two with aluminium armour), two M.2 heat sinks, chipset heat sink, SATA ports, coin cell, audio capacitors, pin headers and fan headers; no logos, no moving parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
